CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSILENT

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Everything between <CFSILENT> and </CFSILENT> runs normally (queries execute, variables are set) but nothing it writes reaches the browser, not even text inside a CFOUTPUT. It is the simplest way to keep the blank lines of a long stretch of CFSET and CFQUERY tags out of your page.

Category

Output and page processing

Syntax

<CFSILENT>
  CFML whose output is discarded
</CFSILENT>

Usage

Errors raised inside the block are not silenced: they propagate to CFTRY/CFCATCH or the error page as usual.

CFSILENT affects only its own body. To suppress output selectively across a whole page use CFSETTING ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY; to keep the output but squeeze the whitespace use CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSILENT>
  This text, the blank lines below and even the CFOUTPUT are discarded.
  <CFQUERY NAME="Staff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
  SELECT Department, Salary FROM Employees
  </CFQUERY>
  <CFSET Payroll = ArraySum(ListToArray(ValueList(Staff.Salary)))>
  <CFSET Average = Payroll / Staff.RecordCount>
  <CFOUTPUT>You will never see this line.</CFOUTPUT>
</CFSILENT>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Employees</TD><TD ALIGN=RIGHT>#Staff.RecordCount#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Annual payroll</TD><TD ALIGN=RIGHT>#DollarFormat(Payroll)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Average salary</TD><TD ALIGN=RIGHT>#DollarFormat(Average)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<P>The variables set inside CFSILENT are available afterwards.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>
